Indices of nonzero elements

Source: R/numpy_array.R
jnp_argwhere.Rd

Ports of jnp.argwhere (a (N, ndim) array of coordinates) and jnp.flatnonzero (indices into the flattened array). The number of results depends on the data, so inside jit, vmap or grad a static size is required; missing entries are padded with fill_value (default 0) and extra entries are dropped.

Usage

jnp_argwhere(a, size = NULL, fill_value = NULL)

jnp_flatnonzero(a, size = NULL, fill_value = NULL)

Arguments

a

Array.

size

Optional static number of results.

fill_value

Optional padding value.

Value

An integer array.
